name: Cloud Agent

        description: Optional OpenRouter API key (overrides secret)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/10 * * * *"

jobs:
  run-agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Install openai
        run: npm install openai

      - name: Prepare state

          mkdir -p .agent-state
          if [ ! -f .agent-state/memory.json ]; then
            echo '{"messages":[],"last_task":"","last_answer":""}' > .agent-state/memory.json

          if [ ! -f .agent-state/inbox.txt ]; then

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agent-result
          path: |
            agent-result.md
            agent-result.txt
            .agent-state/
          retention-days: 14
